events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street & 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Public outdoor pop-up celebrating KILIAN PARIS's Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last; exclusive gifts require purchase.
events.caveats: Complimentary items are while supplies last. Gifts with purchase are not free giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Open to the public at Chelsea Triangle on Friday Sept. 18, noon–8 PM.

events.address: Pura Vida Nolita, 98 Kenmare Street, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Two-day Brown Bee activation at Pura Vida Nolita.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests to get a PB Smoothie receive a full-size Brown Bee product and exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: The giveaway is limited to the first 100 and is tied to getting a PB Smoothie; do not present the product/gift as an unconditional freebie.
events.practical_notes: Open to the public Sept. 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily.

events.event_name: Café Yaeji: Oatly × Yaeji Free Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: Two-day immersive café inspired by Korean dabangs, created by Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base, salted vanilla cold foam and gochugaru.
events.caveats: Free drinks are offered during the advertised pop-up; supply limits are not quantified in the sources, so availability should not be assumed all day.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM daily at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up × Sephora
events.address: Sept. 19: Sephora, 21-27 9th Avenue; Sept. 20: Sephora, 40 East 14th Street, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty sampling tour at two Manhattan Sephora locations.
events.what_is_free: Product trials, exclusive free gifts while supplies last, and prize-entry opportunities. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the advertised freebies; separate gifts with purchase require $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchase.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Purchase thresholds apply only to the separate GWP offers. Each date has a different Sephora location and Eventbrite registration page.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19: Meatpacking, 21-27 9th Ave. Sunday Sept. 20: Union Square, 40 E 14th St. Both noon–6 PM.

events.what_it_is: Three-day immersive SACHEU beauty pop-up with product consultations, games, prizes and an installation.
events.what_is_free: Advertised full-size product for attendees while supplies last, plus games/prizes. Separate gift-with-purchase requires proof of a qualifying recent Ulta SACHEU purchase.
events.caveats: RSVP explicitly does not guarantee entry, attendance or a place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Promotional products are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 11 AM–5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first NYC café-and-retail pop-up, launching the coffee-inspired Mocha Magic fragrance.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 guests in line each day. Drinks, merchandise and retail products are available for purchase; gifts with purchase are separate.
events.caveats: First-50 gift is limited daily. The café and store are shoppable; do not imply drinks or merchandise are complimentary.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street. Walk-ins are accepted; a Partiful RSVP may be available but is not established as required admission.
